# Source values and values used in this model

[Project home](../README.md) · [Folder guide](project_structure.md)

Actual model parameter tables

**Source value:** a verified value from the author’s original work or cited literature, in the listed units. **Value used in this model:** the actual value read back from the assembled simulation. **What changed and why:** the source-to-model difference and documented rationale. “Not established” means no verified numerical source value is available; the model value is an assumption, estimate or fitted value. Successful fitting does not prove that a fitted value is the animal’s true parameter.

Positions use their specified local body frame. Initial conditions appear separately below. Displayed scalars use up to eight significant digits; saved JSON/CSV values retain full precision. Editing a parameter requires a new simulation and does not automatically retune excitation.
